Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to set up our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my schedule, a few slots are free:

- Monday 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

Would any of those work for you, or is there a time you'd prefer? Once you confirm I'll put it on my calendar.
